24349-coming-home-1916.title: Coming Home 1916
24349-coming-home-1916.creator: Edith Wharton
24349-coming-home-1916.description: A book by Edith Wharton. ON my first dash to the Northern fighting line--Greer told me the other night--I carried supplies to an ambulance where the surgeon asked me to have a talk with an officer who was badly wounded and fretting for news of his people in the east of France.

arxiv-2203-07376.title: HIE-SQL: History Information Enhanced Network for Context-Dependent Text-to-SQL Semantic Parsing
arxiv-2203-07376.creator: Yanzhao Zheng, Haibin WangBaohua DongXingjun Wang, Changshan LiAlibaba Group, Hangzhou, China {zhengyanzhao.zyz,binke.whb,baohua.dbh,xingjun.wxj}@alibaba-inc.com , lics16@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2203-07376.description: Abstract Recently, context-dependent text-to-SQL semantic parsing which translates natural language into SQL in an interaction process has attracted a lot of attention. Previous works leverage context-dependence information either from interaction history utterances or the previous predicted SQL queries but fail in taking advantage of both since of the mismatch between natural language and logic-form SQL.

arxiv-2209-07464.title: The Impending Opacity Challenge in Exoplanet Atmospheric Characterization
arxiv-2209-07464.creator: Prajwal Niraula 1,∗, Julien de Wit 1,∗, Iouli E. Gordon 2, Robert J. Hargreaves 2, Clara Sousa-Silva 2, Roman V. Kochanov 2,3,4
arxiv-2209-07464.description: Abstract With a new generation of observatories coming online this decade, the process of characterizing exoplanet atmospheres will need to be reinvented. Currently mostly on the instrumental side, characterization bottlenecks will soon stand by the models used to translate spectra into atmospheric properties.

arxiv-2309-11682.title: Dr. FERMI: A Stochastic Distributionally Robust Fair Empirical Risk Minimization Framework
arxiv-2309-11682.creator: Sina Baharlouei, Meisam Razaviyayn
arxiv-2309-11682.description: Abstract While training fair machine learning models has been studied extensively in recent years, most developed methods rely on the assumption that the training and test data have similar distributions. In the presence of distribution shifts, fair models may behave unfairly on test data. There have been some developments for fair learning robust to distribution shifts to address this shortcoming.

arxiv-2407-04003.title: Fully Fine-tuned CLIP Models are Efficient Few-Shot Learners
arxiv-2407-04003.creator: Mushui Liu, Bozheng Li, Yunlong Yu Zhejiang University
arxiv-2407-04003.description: Abstract Prompt tuning, which involves training a small set of parameters, effectively enhances the pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to downstream tasks. However, they often come at the cost of flexibility and adaptability when the tuned models are applied to different datasets or domains.

arxiv-2501-07544.title: C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{*} -supports and abnormalities of operator systems Thanks: R.C. was partially supported by an NSERC Discovery Grant.
arxiv-2501-07544.creator: Raphaël Clouâtre, Colin Krisko
arxiv-2501-07544.description: Abstract . Let S S be a concrete operator system represented on some Hilbert space H H . A C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{*} -support of S S is the C ∗ \mathrm{C}^{*} -algebra generated (via the Choi–Effros product) by S S inside an injective operator system acting on H H .

arxiv-2510-03128.title: On Nearly Frobenius structures
arxiv-2510-03128.creator: William Davis and Olivia Dumitrescu
arxiv-2510-03128.description: Abstract . Nearly Frobenius structures and 2-dimensional Almost TQFTs were introduced and shown to be in categorical equivalence in [ 12 ] in the attempt to extend the Atiyah-Segal’s definition to the category of infinite dimensional vector spaces. In this paper, we investigate nearly Frobenius structures and we give a classification result for Almost TQFTs in dimension 2.

pmc-10603748.title: Fibroblast Growth Factor-23 (FGF-23) in Dogs—Reference Interval and Correlation with Hematological and Biochemical Parameters
pmc-10603748.creator: Sandra Lapsina, Nicole Nagler, Simon Franz Müller, Annette Holtdirk, Tanja Kottmann, Elisabeth Müller, Ingo Schäfer
pmc-10603748.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Simple SummaryFibroblast growth factor-23 (FGF-23) is a biomarker for the monitoring of chronic kidney disease in humans. The clinical relevance of FGF-23 in dogs is largely unknown. The aim of this study was (1) to show the intra- and interassay precision of the Kainos ELISA FGF-23 kit, (2) to determine a reference interval for FGF-23 in dogs, and (3) to investigate the possible correlations of the FGF-23 concentrations with other hematological and biochemical parameters.

pmc-11503083.description: ObjectivesThe objectives were to assess the prospective associations between work-related factors, including psychosocial and physical work factors and working time/hours factors, and sickness presenteeism alone or combined with sickness absence.MethodsThe study relied on prospective data of a national representative sample of 16 129 employees followed up from 2013 to 2016 in France.

pmc-11585760.title: A nonnatural peptide targeting the A-kinase anchoring function of PI3Kγ for therapeutic cAMP modulation in pulmonary cells
pmc-11585760.creator: Angela Della Sala, Laura Tasca, Cosmin Butnarasu, Valentina Sala, Giulia Prono, Alessandra Murabito, Olga Valentina Garbero, Enrico Millo, Leonardo Terranova, Francesco Blasi, Andrea Gramegna, Stefano Aliberti, Alberto Massarotti, Sonja Visentin, Emilio Hirsch, Alessandra Ghigo
pmc-11585760.description: A-kinase anchoring proteins (AKAPs) are key orchestrators of cAMP signaling that act by recruiting protein kinase A (PKA) in proximity of its substrates and regulators to specific subcellular compartments. Modulation of AKAPs function offers the opportunity to achieve compartment-restricted modulation of the cAMP/PKA axis, paving the way to new targeted treatments.

pmc-11608209.title: Engineering Komagataella phaffii for ethylene glycol production from xylose

pmc-11608209.description: Ethylene glycol (EG) is a versatile molecule produced in the petrochemical industry and is widely used to manufacture plastic polymers, anti-freeze, and automotive fluids. Biotechnological production of EG from xylose, a pentose present in lignocellulose biomass hydrolysates, has been achieved by the engineering of bacteria, such as Escherichia coli and Enterobacter cloacae, and the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae with synthetic pathways.

pmc-11975518.title: 治疗前外周血血红蛋白×淋巴细胞/单核细胞水平对鼻咽癌患者预后的影响
pmc-11975518.creator: Chao DENG, Zui CHEN, Jie LING, Yangchun XIE, Xiayan ZHAO, Chunhong HU, Xianling LIU, Yuhua FENG, Tao HOU, 敏宁 彭
pmc-11975518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). 目的外周全血细胞计数可作为多种肿瘤的预后预测因子，但其在鼻咽癌预后中的预测价值仍未可知。本研究探讨治疗前外周血血红蛋白×淋巴细胞/单核细胞(hemoglobin×lymphocyte/monocyte ratio，HLMR)水平对接受根治性放疗的非复发转移性鼻咽癌患者预后的影响。方法回顾性分析805例完成根治性放疗或放化疗的鼻咽癌患者的临床病理资料及随访记录，收集患者治疗前的外周血血红蛋白、淋巴细胞计数和单核细胞计数结果，计算HLMR值，绘制受试者操作特征(receiver operating characteristic，ROC)曲线，并判定患者HLMR的最佳临界值；根据最佳临界值，将患者分为高HLMR组和低HLMR组，使用χ 2检验分析HLMR与患者临床病理特征的关系；使用Cox风险模型确定影响鼻咽癌患者总生存期和无进展生存期的独立危险因素。根据独立危险因素建立诺莫图，预测患者的生存率，并利用验证队列进行内部验证。结果ROC曲线显示HLMR对鼻咽癌患者5年生存率的最佳临界值为605.5，多因素Cox回归分析显示：T分期(HR=1.886，95% CI 1.331~2.673，P<0.001)，N分期(HR=2.021，95% CI 1.267~3.225，P=0.003)，美国东部肿瘤协作组(Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group，ECOG)评分(HR=3.991，95% CI 1.257~12.677，P=0.019)，同步放化疗模式(HR=0.338，95% CI 0.156~0.731，P=0.006)，HLMR(HR=0.648，95% CI 0.460~0.912，P=0.013)为患者总生存期的独立预后因素。在训练队列中，纳入T分期、N分期、HLMR等因素建立诺莫图预测患者3、5和7年的总生存率，该模型的C-index为0.713，其对患者3、5和7年生存率预测的曲线下面积分别为0.744、0.665和0.682，校正曲线分析表明该模型预测的患者生存率与实际观察到的患者生存率具有较好的一致性。上述结果在验证队列中得到进一步证明。结论治疗前HLMR可能是一个有潜力的鼻咽癌患者预后预测标志物。Keywords: 血红蛋白×淋巴细胞/单核细胞, 鼻咽癌, 生存率, 临床病理特征, 预后标志物 鼻咽癌(nasopharyngeal carcinoma，NPC)是原发于鼻咽部的恶性肿瘤，发病与EB病毒感染密切相关，具有明显的地区流行性，全球有近一半的病例发生在中国[1]。新发NPC患者中，局部晚期患者占70%以上，标准治疗以放化疗为主[2]。经过标准方案治疗后，15%~30%的局晚期NPC患者最终出现复发或转移[3]。因此，研究影响NPC预后的因素对改善NPC患者的预后具有十分重要的意义。研究[4]表明炎症反应与肿瘤的发生、发展及预后密切相关。激活的免疫细胞通过诱导DNA损害、干扰DNA修复从而加速肿瘤进展[5]。其中，外周全血细胞计数能够反映潜在的炎症反应，是研究热点之一。外周血免疫指标包括血小板、血红蛋白、中性粒细胞、淋巴细胞、单核细胞、巨噬细胞等。研究[6-10]证实中性粒细胞和淋巴细胞比值(neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio，NLR)、血小板和淋巴细胞比值(platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio，PLR)、系统性免疫炎症指数(systemic immune inflammation index，SII)、系统性炎症反应指数(systemic inflammation response index，SIRI)能够作为多种肿瘤的预后预测因子。血红蛋白、淋巴细胞和单核细胞比值能够预测多种肿瘤(包括NPC)的预后[11-12]。外周血血红蛋白×淋巴细胞/单核细胞(hemoglobin×lymphocyte/monocyte，HLMR)是一个新的组合指标，其在NPC中的预后价值尚无文献报道。 本研究通过回顾性分析805例完成根治性放疗或放化疗的NPC患者的临床病理资料及随访记录，分析HLMR作为预测非复发转移性NPC预后的可行性，旨在应用HLMR对NPC患者进行预后分层。 资料与方法 临床资料 选取2013年1月至2019年12月中南大学湘雅二医院收治的接受根治性放疗或放化疗的初治NPC患者805例。纳入标准：1)经组织病理学确诊为NPC；2)接受根治性调强适形放疗；3)有治疗前完整的影像学检查结果及血常规结果。排除标准：1)未完成放疗计划；2)治疗前有出血、贫血、感染、肝肾功能不全等合并症；3)有免疫系统、血液系统及其他恶性肿瘤等合并症；4)治疗前半个月内使用激素治疗(患者纳入、排除流程见图1)。 患者纳入和排除流程图 Figure 1 Consort diagram for patient inclusion and exclusion 收集所有入组患者治疗前的人口学信息、临床信息等，包括年龄、性别、身高、体重、美国东部肿瘤协作组(Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group，ECOG)评分、T分期、N分期、临床分期、治疗方案、外周血血红蛋白、外周血淋巴细胞、单核细胞计数及随访信息等，建立数据库进行分析。本研究已获得中南大学湘雅二医院伦理委员会的批准(伦审[临研]第092号)。 治疗方法 放疗 所有患者均采用调强放疗技术，接受直线加速器6 MV-X线照射。根据ICRU50号及ICRU62号报告的原则进行靶区勾画。鼻咽部原发灶剂量70 Gy/31~33次，颈部淋巴结转移灶剂量70 Gy/31~33次，亚临床病灶及高危淋巴结引流区剂量60 Gy/31~33次，低危淋巴结引流区剂量54~56 Gy/31~33次。根据RTOG0225的原则勾画危及器官及限定剂量。 诱导及辅助化疗 所有III~IVa期及部分II期患者接受1~3个疗程的诱导化疗，诱导化疗方案：以顺铂或奈达铂为基础的双药方案。根据患者临床分期及放疗后复查情况，部分患者接受1~2周期含铂双药化疗或单药卡培他滨化疗。 同期化疗 根据患者临床分期及耐受性，部分患者放疗同期采用顺铂或奈达铂 100 mg/m2，每3~4周为1周期，共1~3周期。 随访 治疗结束后的1年内每3个月复查1次，1年后每6个月复查1次，5年后每年复查1次，采用电话、门诊或住院方式进行随访。末次随访时间为2023年4月30日。主要研究终点为总生存期(overall survival，OS)，次要研究终点为无进展生存时间(progression free survival，PFS)。OS定义为治疗开始至患者死亡的时间，PFS定义为治疗开始至疾病进展或患者死亡的时间。 观察指标 收集患者治疗前72 h内的血常规结果，记录血红蛋白、淋巴细胞计数及单核细胞计数等数值，计算HLMR。 统计学处理 采用SPSS 26.0统计学软件及R软件(4.1.3版)进行数据分析。HLMR的最佳临界值采用受试者操作特征(receiver operating characteristic，ROC)曲线确定，依据约登指数确定HLMR的最佳临界值。HLMR与各临床病理学参数间的相关性采用χ 2检验，采用Kaplan-Meier法计算生存率，生存率的组间差别采用Log-rank检验。采用Cox回归模型进行多因素分析，P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。最后，纳入Cox回归分析中的独立预后因素建立诺莫图，并检验其对患者OS和PFS的预测效能。 结 果 患者临床资料的基线特征

pmc-12541327.title: The intestinal environment potentiates bacteriophage adaptation in response to phenotypic resistance in Salmonella Typhimurium
pmc-12541327.creator: Nicolas Wenner, Anouk Bertola, Louise Larsson, Andrea Rocker, Nahimi Amare Bekele, Chris Sauerbeck, Leonardo F. Lemos Rocha, Valentin Druelle, Marco Molari, Alexander Harms, Médéric Diard
pmc-12541327.description: SignificanceUnderstanding phage–bacteria coevolution is critical for the design of robust phage-based therapy. Heterogenous expression of surface glycan modifications known as phase variation allows populations of Salmonella Typhimurium to include both phenotypically phage-resistant and susceptible cells, enabling coexistence with certain virulent bacteriophages.

pmc-12615693.title: Irradiated obese adipocytes are prone to oxidative stress, inflammation, senescence, and fibrosis
pmc-12615693.creator: Simran Takkar, Elizabeth A Kosmacek, Joshua A McDowell, Kia T Liermann-Wooldrik, Arpita Chatterjee, Rebecca E Oberley-Deegan
pmc-12615693.description: Cancer patients with obesity who undergo radiotherapy are more likely to suffer from side effects caused by the radiation-induced damage to normal tissues adjacent to the tumor. Exposure of these normal tissues during radiation treatment results in post-irradiation related chronic damage leading to fibrosis. Obese adipose tissue is associated with oxidative stress promoting oxidative damage, senescence, inflammation, and fibrosis.
